Sam — great to have you across the finish line. I've reviewed your MAP and sketched a coordinated implementation plan below; attaching Redwood's canonical runbook snippets I'll use to populate the shared tracker.

Proposed embedded MAP (summary):
1) Pre-kickoff (Day -3 to Day 0)
   - Shared config baseline (model version pinning + tokenization checks)
   - Prefix cache warmup with synthetic traces
   - Access & IAM verification for Fathom SREs (VPC peering check)
2) Sandbox validation (Day 1–2)
   - Smoke tests, latency profiling, KV cache behavior validation
   - Two training sessions for ops & product (90 min each) — attendees: SREs, PMs, Support
3) Canary ramp (Day 3–5)
   - 0% -> 10% (24h) -> 25% (24h) -> 60% (24h); automated rollback thresholds at error rate > 2.5% or latency P95 increase > 60%
   - Runbook: canary switch, traffic steering, and fallback model variant (quantized v3)
4) Full migration & cutover (Day 6)
   - Final verification checklist, production traffic switch, and observability bake period (48h)

Training windows we can run (EST):
- Tue 2026-09-15 10:00–11:30 — Ops & Runbook walkthrough
- Wed 2026-09-16 14:00–15:30 — Troubleshooting & fallback drills

Questions/asks for Fathom before kickoff:
- Confirm the sandbox dataset and access window (we'll need read-only access for 48h)
- Confirm preferred canary start time zone (we recommend starting the canary at 00:00 UTC to align with low-traffic window)
- Any constraints for routing traffic between regions?

I'll tag these into HubSpot and attach the runbook PDFs. Marissa — can you confirm node reservation options for the initial canary? Aditya — any commercial notes (SLA exception or one-time credits) we should confirm now so procurement can process quickly?

Operational considerations (from Redwood infra):
- We can reserve a 48–72 hour dedicated pool (3x p4d-equivalent) for the canary window. Recommend enabling burst reserve for the first 12h to absorb cache cold-start spikes.

- Observability: enable token-level tracing for the canary cohort and hook the traces to the MAP evaluation set so we can measure quality regressions in parallel with latency.
